ignoreCommand: if [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] || [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" ]; then echo 'Git baseline unavailable; building'; exit 1; fi; if git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" -- web package.json package-lock.json vercel.json .vercelignore; then echo 'No web deployment inputs changed; skipping Vercel build'; exit 0; else echo 'Web deployment inputs changed; building'; exit 1; fi
